TABLE OF CONTENTS · Eni: report on the purchase of treasury shares on 8 May 2026 SIGNATURE Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned, thereunto duly authorized. Eni S.p.A. (Registrant) Date: May 13, 2026 By: /s/ Giulia Saba (Signature) Name: Giulia Saba Title: Head of Company Secretariat Eni: report on the purchase of treasury shares on 8 May 2026 San Donato Milanese (Milan), 13 May 2026 – On 8 May 2026, Eni acquired on the Euronext Milan no. 875,813 shares (equal to 0.03% of the share capital), at a weighted average price per share equal to 22.8359 euro, for a total consideration of 19,999,978.09 euro, within the first tranche of the treasury shares program approved by the Shareholders' Meeting on 6 May 2026, for the purpose of serving the 2026-2028 Incentive Plan, resolved by the same Shareholders’ Meeting. Considering the treasury shares already held and the purchases made, Eni holds n. 87,703,920 shares equal to 2.90% of the share capital. Details of the hourly transactions made during 8 May.
